text: 46 1. Listen and recite. 2. Listen, repeat and write. 3. Complete the following lines. Open a book And you will find People and places of every kind; Open a book And you can be Anything that you want to be; Open a book And you can share Wondrous worlds you find in there; (1) Open a book and you will find, ___________ and ___________ of every kind. (2) Open a book and you can share, Wondrous ___________ you find in there. Open a book And I will too You read to me And I’ll read to you. -Jane Baskwill Open a book. 3.5 kind people wondrous anything share worlds For the Teacher : • Encourage the children to read books. • Ask the children to discuss about them.
